titulo: Me warming up before my run
caption:
Me warming up before my run

Me warming up before my run.

Five to ten minutes of easy movement is plenty of warm-up for an easy run. After that you are just stretching the start.

Send it to the friend who stretches until it is too late to run.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A staircase room. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left and stretches, leaning to one side, then the other, then growing tall, again and again with a small pulse, while a digital clock on the right climbs from 0:05 to 0:40. In the last seconds the text changes from: me warming up before my run, to: warm-up: 40 minutes. run: tomorrow. Its eyes go wide and it trembles, then it narrows its eyes at the camera.
